items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: Earl took my job with Jimmy Newman at the Apex.

ctx.x: He was good. And then when I left, went to Europe in 26 wide, Earl took my job with Jimmy Newman at the Apex. The Apex. Yeah. Earl took over. That was my job. If I had stayed in.
You hadn't started at the Apex, so you'd been up on 40. No.
